reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text: this is a good toner!! i plan on using it on my exfoliation routine evenings. it hurts a little bit if you have any blemish areas with damaged skin, but still moisturizes and provides a nice sheen before absorbing fully into the skin.
reviews.zh: 呢支toner好好！！我打算喺晚上去角質嘅步驟用。如果皮膚有破損嘅暗瘡位會有少少刺痛，但仍然做到保濕，仲喺完全吸收之前畀皮膚一層好好嘅光澤。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text:
パッド、トナー、セラム、パック
おすすめです！あと実はミストが1番すごい！使った瞬間から感動します！もちもち肌⚪️
reviews.zh:

推薦！仲有，其實噴霧先係最厲害！用嘅瞬間已經好感動！彈彈肌⚪️

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text: Bit too heavy for my skin, considering it’s a toner.
reviews.zh: 對我皮膚嚟講有少少厚重，畢竟佢係toner。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text: Extremely soothing. A nice texture than feels substantial without being too heavy or sticky.
reviews.zh: 超級舒緩。質地好好，感覺豐厚但又唔會太厚重或者黏笠。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text: Me gusta mucho, pero creo que es muy bueno para una piel seca o madura. Para una piel grasa la encuentro un poco pesada !
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，但覺得佢比較適合乾性或者熟齡肌。油性肌用嘅話我覺得有少少厚重！

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text: Helped improve chin acne through gentle exfoliation.
reviews.zh: 透過溫和去角質，幫助改善下巴位嘅暗瘡。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text: Aún no lo uso ya que estoy utilizando la línea de Haruharu wonder. Cuando se me termine empezare a utilizar la línea completa de Abib. Lo compre porque he utilizado excelentes comentarios como línea de vejez
reviews.zh: 我仲未用，因為我而家用緊 Haruharu wonder 嘅系列。用完之後就會開始轉用 Abib 成個系列。買佢係因為睇過好多好評，話呢個系列可以抗老。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose PHA Toner Skin Booster 200mL
reviews.text: it has a thick consistency for a toner, however it is fast absorbing. its also hydrating.
reviews.zh: 對toner嚟講，質地比較杰，但吸收得快，而且都好保濕。
